   224: /// Runs the management service, publishing the snapshot the moment it serves.
   225: ///
   226: /// `serving` is called exactly once, after the listener is bound and the
   227: /// readiness line has been logged, with the same [`ServeReport`] the run will
   228: /// eventually return. Nothing in the report changes between that moment and the
   229: /// end of the run — it is a startup snapshot — so a supervisor (or a test that
   230: /// bound an ephemeral port) can act on it without waiting for shutdown.
   231: ///
   232: /// It is a parameter rather than a global so that publishing readiness is not
   233: /// something a later edit can add for one deployment and forget for another.
   234: pub async fn run_publishing(
   235:     config: ServeConfig,
   236:     shutdown: impl Future<Output = ()>,
   237:     serving: impl FnOnce(&ServeReport),
   238: ) -> Result<ServeReport, ServeError> {
   239:     // 1. Validate before anything authority-bearing is opened.
   240:     let runtime_config = config.http.runtime_config()?;
   241:     let off_host = config.is_off_host_bind();
   242: 
   243:     // 2. The worker opens the store and attempts the startup reconcile. Both a
   244:     //    failure here and a degraded outcome return here; only a degraded one
   245:     //    lets the run continue. A state failure is the fatal case: the process
   246:     //    exits without ever binding, because there is no authoritative state to
   247:     //    administer and a live surface would be a lie.
   248:     let worker = match spawn(WorkerConfig::new(&config.state_path, &config.netd_socket)) {
   249:         Ok(worker) => worker,
   250:         Err(error) => {
   251:             // Reported before returning so an operator sees the *classified*
   252:             // reason, not only the underlying error. The reason reaches the log
   253:             // and nowhere else -- there is no listener to serve it from.
   254:             crate::operational::emit(
   255:                 "serve.degraded",
   256:                 crate::operational::Severity::Error,
   257:                 "serve",
   258:                 "startup",
   259:                 "database_unavailable",
   260:                 None,
   261:                 None,
   262:                 Some("state_open"),
   263:             );
   264:             return Err(ServeError::State(error));
   265:         }
   266:     };
   267:     let reconcile = worker.reconcile();
   268:     let startup_readiness = Readiness::from_startup(reconcile);
   269: 
   270:     // 3. Bind.
   271:     let server = Server::builder().runtime(runtime_config).build()?;
   272:     let handle = server
   273:         .start_with_service(super::service::ManagementService::new(
   274:             super::AuthenticatedApi::new(
   275:                 worker.client().clone(),
   276:                 Arc::new(config.origin.clone()),
   277:                 config.limiter(),
   278:             ),
   279:         ))
   280:         .await?;
   281:     let bound = handle.local_addr();
   282:     let (control, mut completion) = handle.into_parts();
   283: 
   284:     // 4. Report readiness, including the exposure mode an operator must be able
   285:     //    to see from the log of a headless install.
   286:     crate::operational::emit(
   287:         "serve.started",
   288:         crate::operational::Severity::Info,
   289:         "serve",
   290:         "startup",
   291:         if startup_readiness.is_degraded() {
   292:             "degraded"
   293:         } else if off_host {
   294:             "off_host"
   295:         } else {
   296:             "ready"
   297:         },
   298:         Some(("http_listener", &bound.to_string())),
   299:         reconcile.generation().map(|g| g.to_storage() as u64),
   300:         Some("reconcile"),
   301:     );
   302:     crate::operational::emit(
   303:         "serve.reconcile",
   304:         if startup_readiness.is_degraded() {
   305:             crate::operational::Severity::Warn
   306:         } else {
   307:             crate::operational::Severity::Info
   308:         },
   309:         "serve",
   310:         "startup_reconcile",
   311:         reconcile.as_str(),
   312:         None,
   313:         reconcile.generation().map(|g| g.to_storage() as u64),
   314:         Some("startup"),
   315:     );
   316:     if startup_readiness.is_degraded() {
   317:         crate::operational::emit(
   318:             "serve.degraded",
   319:             crate::operational::Severity::Warn,
   320:             "serve",
   321:             "startup_reconcile",
   322:             "not_converged",
   323:             None,
   324:             reconcile.generation().map(|g| g.to_storage() as u64),
   325:             Some("reconcile"),
   326:         );
   327:     }
   328:     if off_host {
   329:         crate::operational::emit(
   330:             "serve.degraded",
   331:             crate::operational::Severity::Warn,
   332:             "serve",
   333:             "listener_policy",
   334:             "off_host_without_tls_termination",
   335:             None,
   336:             None,
